sources: Medical Dialogues - Renowned oncologist Dr Dattatreyudu Nori awarded Padma Bhushan
GAPIO - World-renowned radiation oncologist Dr Dattatreyudu Nori
caption:
He spent decades treating cancer in New York. India just gave him its third-highest civilian honour.

Dr. Dattatreyudu Nori, born in Mantada village, Andhra Pradesh, spent his career as Professor and Chairman of Oncology at Cornell Medical Center in New York. While still practicing in the US, he became a founding member and Chief Scientific Advisor of the Basavatarakam Indo-American Cancer Hospital in Hyderabad - a 500-bed, not-for-profit center inaugurated by PM Vajpayee. He now also advises the governments of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana on cancer care.

He built his career at one of America's top cancer centers. He built a 500-bed hospital back home at the same time.
